# Dynex Capital, Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 05, 2026 4:15 pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://www.dynexcapital.com/_assets/_980cc64a7e7b2836f10d6112a3bc0a3b/dynexcapital/news/2026-10-05_Dynex_Capital_Inc_Schedules_Third_Quarter_2026_428.pdf)


GLEN ALLEN, Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Dynex Capital, Inc. (NYSE: DX; “Dynex” or the “Company”), a REIT with a long track record of generating dividends from high-quality mortgage assets, announced today that it will release its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 before market open on Monday, October 19, 2026. In addition, Dynex’s management team will host a conference call and live audio webcast to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results that same morning at 10:00 a.m. ET.


**Conference Call Details**


**To listen by telephone** , participants can[click here](https://myconferencinghub.com/click-to-join/3227135) and enter their contact information to be connected by phone. Participants may also dial **(800) 330-6710** and enter conference code **3227135** . Participants are encouraged to connect at least 10 minutes before the call begins.


**To listen to the call and view the presentation online** , participants can[click here](https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1774234&tp_key=e9e94a0cd7) to access the live webcast or click the "Webcast" button on the Investors page of the Company's website ([www.dynexcapital.com/investors](https://www.dynexcapital.com/investors) ). The webcast includes both the audio and presentation materials and does not require a telephone connection. The webcast will become active 15 minutes prior to the scheduled start time.


A replay will be available approximately two hours after the conclusion of the live event through the same webcast link and on the Company’s website.


**About Dynex Capital**


Dynex Capital, Inc. (NYSE: DX) is a leading internally managed REIT with a long track record of delivering attractive dividends through the disciplined risk management of investments in high-quality mortgage assets backed by U.S. residential and commercial real estate. For more information on Dynex, please visit our website at[www.dynexcapital.com](http://www.dynexcapital.com/) or connect with us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dynex-capital-inc) .
